metadata.title: Common Shade Module E: what works, what stalls, and the blind spots
metadata.method: Structured evidence synthesis of four saved module libraries with targeted primary-source checks; not an exhaustive systematic review or meta-analysis.
metadata.numeric_result_basis: Keep measured, modelled and claimed results separate; source kinds are not quality rankings.
metadata.no_endorsement: Inclusion implies neither partnership nor endorsement.
metadata.whole_package_cost_limit: No validated, comparable complete-package cost range found; missing values are null, never zero.
metadata.innovation_date_limit: SHAPES start date not verified; included as current research to follow, not claimed newly invented in 2024–2026.

packages.name: Cooler homes with protection through the night
packages.package_status_explanation: Researcher-proposed combination; component evidence does not establish complete-package effectiveness.
packages.loop_mapping_basis: Analytical inference about pathways; no quantified proof of breaking an entire feedback loop.

sequence.action: Agree tenant/owner permissions and identify residents unable to leave.
Measure occupied-room day/night heat and inspect roof structure, leaks and wiring.
Select shading/roof treatment and ventilation appropriate to outside conditions.
Provide conditional fan use, targeted cooled refuge and an outage fallback.
Assign cleaning, repairs, electricity support and review after the hot season.
